sources.entry: Pencil2D Animation - Pencil2D is an animation/drawing software for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It lets you create traditional hand-drawn animation (cartoon) using both bitmap and vector graphics.

summary.one_liner: Pencil2D is a free, open source 2D animation and drawing program for traditional hand-drawn (cartoon-style) animation using bitmap and vector graphics.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Pencil2D as animation and drawing software for Windows, macOS, Linux, and FreeBSD, aimed at traditional hand-drawn cartoon-style animation. It supports both bitmap and vector graphics. Downloads are offered from an official website and GitHub releases, with nightly builds available for testing newer, less stable changes. A Quick Reference guide is built into the app under Help > Quick Reference Guide, and the README links to a user manual, tutorials, an FAQ, and discussion forums. The README also covers contributing: issue tracker, developer guide for compiling from source, Transifex for translations, and documentation contributions. Source is primarily on GitHub, with Bitbucket and GitLab mirrors.
use_cases: test pre-release builds of an animation tool
contribute translations or compile from source
how_to_run: Download Pencil2D from the official website or GitHub releases
Optionally download a nightly build for the latest changes
Open the app and use Help > Quick Reference Guide for an overview
Follow the developer guide in the project to compile from source
notable: Supports both bitmap and vector drawing in one animation tool
Cross-platform: Windows, macOS, Linux, and FreeBSD
Free and open source, developed by volunteers
Built-in Quick Reference Guide and links to a user manual and tutorials
Nightly builds available for testing bleeding-edge features
caveats: Nightly builds are less stable than official releases
Some tutorials may reference older versions of the software
